card.name: Setting up close patient monitoring
card.fires_on: Small words just before an expected word like observation, monitoring, supervision or closely, in sentences about patients who should be watched, hospitalized or followed. Often 'under close', 'should be', or 'such patients'.

modes.label: Under close supervision
modes.description: Words in phrases like 'under close' or 'under continued' that lead to medical supervision or observation.
modes.example: DOSAGE & ADMINISTRATION Patients should be under<< close>> clinical observation when treatment with diazoxide

modes.label: Should be monitored
modes.description: The word 'be' or 'patients' after 'should' or 'monitor such', before closely observed or cautioned.
modes.example: When such drugs are administered to a patient receiving Glipizide and Metformin HCl Tablets, the patient should<< be>> closely observed for loss of blood glucose control

modes.label: Cross-reference to dosing section
modes.description: The start of 'Dosage and Administration' in a section cross-reference.
modes.example: (2.5 mg on Cycle 1 Day 8) [see<< Dos>>age and Administration

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning supervision, monitoring and close follow-up.
card.plain: It fires when a label is about to say a patient needs to be watched or monitored closely.
